name: Yadhu Krishna NM
title: AI Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
tagline: Building intelligent systems at the intersection of AI, computer vision, and elegant engineering.
bio: I'm a second-year BCA student with a strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer vision, and software development, building systems that feel natural, interactive, and human-centered.

My primary project is Aira, an emotionally intelligent AI assistant with real-time 3D avatars and conversational capabilities, alongside computer-vision systems and AI-driven applications engineered end to end.

I care about thoughtful engineering as much as technical capability: every system I build is designed to run efficiently on constrained hardware, and every interface is crafted to deliver meaningful experiences.
